newsitem.title: GERMANY: FOCUS - Daimler's Debis expects strong growth.
newsitem.headline: FOCUS - Daimler's Debis expects strong growth.

text.p: Daimler-Benz AG's financial and information services unit Debis said on Wednesday 1996 sales rose 15 percent to 13.6 billion marks ($8.3 billion), and profits at a faster but unspecified rate.
Debis chief Klaus Mangold described the results as the company's best ever and said that he expected 1997 sales of well over 14 billion marks.
Mangold said that at current growth levels Debis, whose workforce grew to 11,400 employees from 10,200 over the year, would continue creating an extra 1,000 jobs a year.
Debis' core financial service revenue grew 14 percent to 8.7 billion marks, while insurance revenue rose eight percent to 103 million marks.
In its Debitel mobile phone service, sales soared 73 percent to 1.6 billion marks. Debis Systemhaus, an information service unit, saw sales climb 15 percent to 2.2 billion marks.
Trading revenue was up 11 percent to 445 million marks and property management revenue tripled to 207 million marks.

Referring to Debis' 24 percent stake in the French software group Cap Gemini, Mangold said Debis still wanted to increase its holding and hoped that French legislation preventing it from doing so was soon altered.
